the clinical characteristics, outcome, predictors of neurological sequel, and quality of life (QoL) of persistent CHI were studied.

persistent CHI is a rare but severe disease with a high mortality rate.

CHI is a rare but serious disorder that should always be considered in the differential diagnosis of hypoglycemia in neonates and young infants, even in the absence of a family history of CHI.
